subject: Proposal: temporary dedicated GPU reservation for artifact integration sprint
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: temporary dedicated GPU reservation for artifact integration sprint

Team —

We have an upcoming integration sprint for the new model artifact pipeline (internal codename: artifact-sprint). The end-to-end validation and latency regression tests require a stable, preempt-free GPU slab to ensure KV-cache warmups and multi-variant A/B runs are reproducible. Without a short-term reservation, the nightly sweeping jobs are getting evicted mid-run and we can't reproduce a handful of flaky failures.

Request: provision a temporary dedicated carve-out in dedicated-pool-us-west for 6 A100-equivalent GPUs (or capacity equivalent) with autoscale exceptions during the integration windows below:

- Window: June 14 — June 28 (two full weeks)
- Hours: 08:00—20:00 PT (dev/validation); nightly low-priority batch allowed 00:00—06:00 PT but must not preempt the daytime reserved jobs
- Policy ask: mark this slice with autoscale=disabled for the daytime window (prevent soft-eviction) and a soft-preempt threshold after 48 contiguous hours of continuous usage if absolutely needed
- Cost center: ENG-INTEG (we'll allocate)

Why this matters now:
- Integration tests reproduce latency regressions tied to quantized kernel selection under preemption
- Customer pilot (AcmeCloud) integration depends on deterministic results for SLA signoff next month

I've attached a short plan + rough cost estimate (artifact-sprint-plan.pdf; capacity-cost-estimate.xlsx). I'm asking for a decision by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the schedule and notify the partner.

If this needs governance signoff, please advise the quickest path (I can raise a JIRA and route to Finance if required). Happy to do a 15-min sync.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ProductOps <productops@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary dedicated GPU reservation for artifact integration sprint

Vivek —

Thanks for the write-up. A few clarifying points before I can sign off financially: 

1) Exact SKU / equivalence: can you confirm whether this is 6x A100-40GB or 6x A10G? The cost delta matters for month-end reporting.
2) Duration flexibility: is two weeks the minimum or can we split into two 1-week windows?
3) Output ownership: who owns the runbook and post-mortem if we hit infra regressions?

If you can reply inline, I'll run this against the budget code and get back with an ETA for cost approval. Attaching a template estimate I've filled partially (capacity-cost-estimate.xlsx).

Also please add an explicit list of jobs/usernames that should be marked high-priority so we can avoid accidental overrides.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success & Pilot Ops
Redwood Inference

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 10:22:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary dedicated GPU reservation for artifact integration sprint

Vivek / Kim —

We can support a temporary carve-out but need to put clear guardrails in place. Operationally I propose the following, which keeps the platform safe for other tenants: 

- Provision: 6 A100-equivalent slots in dedicated-pool-us-west (tag: ENG-INTEG-artifact)
- Soft preempt: allow reclamation only after we observe 48 contiguous hours of >90% utilization on the slice and only with a 2-hour advance eviction notice to the job owners
- Scheduling: daytime window autoscale disabled; nightly batch runs must run as low-priority jobs that yield to critical customer traffic
- Measurement: we attach a short-runbook and a telemetry dashboard; if utilization exceeds 85% for more than 24 hours we trigger a capacity review

I attached a quick runbook stub (carveout-runbook.md) that lists steps for provisioning, tagging, and teardown. Two operational asks:

1) Vivek — confirm the canonical job names + owner emails (Kim requested this)
2) Kim/Laura — confirm cost center and whether Finance needs a PO before provisioning

If we get confirmation today/tomorrow I can route this to capacity governance and have infra create the slice by June 13.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Capacity Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 14:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary dedicated GPU reservation for artifact integration sprint

Quick note from product: we should avoid a long-running contiguous carve that may overlap with customer pilot windows. Proposal: reduce the daytime carve to 72-hour contiguous windows that we can rotate (i.e., provision for 3 days, tear down, reprovision next block) so we don't block headroom for pilots. Also explore using the dedicated-burst lane for short stress runs rather than a continuous reservation.

If you think the 72-hour block approach won't work for reproducibility, please call out the specific failure modes — otherwise let's try the shorter-window pattern. I'll schedule a 20-min sync with Vivek and Marcus for Thursday to align.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Inference Product
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

- APPROVED (conditional): carve-out of 6 A100-equivalent GPUs in dedicated-pool-us-west for June 14 — June 28 with the guardrails Marcus proposed.
- Cost center: ENG-INTEG (Kim to confirm PO/chargeback by EOD Friday)
- Provisioning owner: Marcus to file JIRA DED-4822 and attach carveout-runbook.md + telemetry dashboard config
- Scheduling: Vivek to provide canonical job names and owner emails by Thu 10 Jun 12:00 PT
- Governance: we will rotate to 72-hour blocks if we observe impact to pilot traffic; Marcus to enable automated alerts at 85% utilization

Marcus — please go ahead and file the JIRA and loop infra. Kim — once you confirm finance path I'll release the charge code. Vivek — please collate the job list and owners and drop into the Drive folder (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-Artifact-Sprint
JIRA: DED-4822
HubSpot note: HS-129847 (partner communications)

I'll update stakeholders and close the loop.

- Laura
